units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:7">Macc. II, 7</cite> <he>אינו יוצא מִשָּׁם לעולם</he> he dare not go away from there (the city of refuge) all his life time; <he>שם תהא דירתו שם וכ׳</he> there he must live, there he must die &c.; Tosef. ib. III (II), 5.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:4">Ber. V, 4</cite> <he>אם אין שם כהן וכ׳</he> if no priest besides him is present; a. v. fr.—
Cant. R. to VIII, 9 שָׁמָּה, v. רגָּז.—לְשָׁם thither.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 18:6">Ex. R. s. 18</cite>; a. fr.
